title: A Novel Hybrid Model Based on a Feedforward Neural Network and One Step Secant Algorithm for Prediction of Load-Bearing Capacity of Rectangular Concrete-Filled Steel Tube Columns.
summary: A hybrid feed-forward neural network and one-step secant optimization model estimated load-bearing capacity of rectangular concrete-filled steel-tube columns from 422 experimental records and was assessed against measured capacities.
ai_technology: Hybrid feed-forward neural network with one-step secant optimization, trained on experimental column-capacity data.

evidence.unknown: The model was assessed against the 422-instance experimental database; validation outside the represented column designs and test conditions is not established.
